Alice.notable_example: Claiming to hear nothing suspicious during the night when she was actively involved in the Mafia kill.

Bob.notable_example: Feigning confusion and suspicion towards Chris and Frank for using agent designations, while being a fellow Mafia member.

Chris.notable_example: His certainty about David being a Villager, which was a moderator fact, was misinterpreted as suspicious by other players, leading to his elimination.

David.notable_example: David was killed on Night 1 and had no opportunity to make any statements or demonstrate deception.

Eve.notable_example: Eve did not participate in the game.

Frank.notable_example: As the Doctor, Frank concealed his role and deliberately withheld his night action, but struggled to articulate a vote, leading to his elimination.
